id: bash-safety blocks rm -rf of filesystem root
provenance: bash-safety-guard DANGEROUS_PATTERNS catastrophic-delete, guarded since the deny-rule complement was added
notes: Recursive delete of the filesystem root must never be executed.

id: bash-safety blocks rm -rf of HOME
provenance: bash-safety-guard catastrophic-delete pattern covers the -fr flag permutation and $HOME expansion
notes: Flag order permutation must not bypass the guard.

id: bash-safety blocks PowerShell recursive force delete of a drive root
provenance: PowerShell branch of catastrophic-delete; this harness runs PowerShell as primary shell
notes: The PowerShell equivalent must be blocked, not only the POSIX form.

id: bash-safety blocks python write into the matlab golden directory
provenance: golden-model-bypass: subprocess write is the documented route around Edit/Write gating
notes: Golden model protection must survive subprocess writes.

id: bash-safety blocks PowerShell Set-Content into matlab
provenance: real gap recorded in bash-safety-guard: golden protection was Bash-hard but PowerShell-empty until this pattern was added
notes: Regression lock for the PowerShell-side golden bypass.

id: bash-safety blocks sed -i against golden sources
provenance: golden-model-bypass sed -i branch
notes: In-place stream edit of a golden reference is a protected write.

id: bash-safety blocks Out-File pipe into fixed_point
provenance: golden-model-bypass pipe form; quantization configs are model inputs
notes: Pipeline redirection is a write, not a read.

id: bash-safety blocks node writeFileSync into rtl sources
provenance: source-write-bypass: writing RTL via subprocess skips hdl-gate and requirements-gate
notes: Source writes must go through Edit/Write so the write gates run.

id: bash-safety blocks shell redirect into a python source file
provenance: source-write-bypass redirect branch
notes: Append redirect into tracked source is still a source write.

id: bash-safety blocks curl exfiltration of .env
provenance: data-exfiltration pattern set
notes: Credential upload must be blocked before the request is made.

id: bash-safety blocks wget post-file of an SSH key
provenance: data-exfiltration wget branch
notes: Private key upload via wget must be blocked.

id: bash-safety blocks piped netcat exfiltration
provenance: data-exfiltration pipe-to-netcat branch
notes: Piping secrets to a raw socket is exfiltration.

id: bash-safety blocks write_bitstream
provenance: no-bit-cfgmem gate: bitstream generation is out of scope for agent project work
notes: Bitstream artifacts are forbidden in agent runs.

id: bash-safety blocks hardware manager open
provenance: no-bit-cfgmem gate covers hardware-programming entry points
notes: Opening the hardware manager implies device programming.

id: bash-safety blocks python read of .env
provenance: sensitive-read-bypass: subprocess read is the documented route around Read-tool deny rules
notes: Reading secrets via subprocess must be blocked.

id: bash-safety allows git status
provenance: the most frequent real command in this repo's transcripts
notes: Read-only git must never be blocked.

id: bash-safety allows the harness test suite
provenance: the repository's own regression entry point
notes: The verification path itself must never be blocked.

id: bash-safety allows pytest
provenance: python verification path used by 02-python rules
notes: Functional verification commands must pass the safety guard.

id: bash-safety allows matlab batch golden recompute
provenance: golden recompute is functional verification per verification-gate TEST_PATTERNS
notes: Running the golden model is reading it, not writing it.

id: bash-safety allows PowerShell read-only pipeline
provenance: real PowerShell usage on this machine; over-blocking here previously forced gate resets
notes: Read-only cmdlets must stay allowed.

id: bash-safety allows reading a config file with cat
provenance: routine inspection command
notes: Reading repository files is not a protected write.

id: verification-verdict accepts explicit RESULT PASS
provenance: real regression output shape from this repository
notes: Explicit PASS evidence with no failure markers is a pass.

id: verification-verdict accepts pytest passed count
provenance: standard pytest summary line
notes: A nonzero passed count with no failures is positive evidence.

id: verification-verdict accepts bit-true simulation evidence

tool_response.stdout: compare done: bit-true against golden, 0 mismatches

provenance: HDL golden-compare output shape used by this repo's TBs
notes: bit-true plus zero mismatches is the HDL pass marker.

id: verification-verdict rejects a nonzero failed test count
provenance: failure marker scan; mixed output must not be read as a pass
notes: A passed count does not cancel a failed count.

id: verification-verdict rejects RESULT FAIL
provenance: explicit failure marker
notes: Explicit FAIL always wins over any other marker.

id: verification-verdict rejects silent simulation output
provenance: real defect: vvp was missing from the log-required list, so empty-output simulations counted as passes
notes: A verification command that produced no log evidence proves nothing.

id: verification-verdict rejects an interrupted command
provenance: real Claude Code payload field; partial output previously read as a pass
notes: Interrupted runs are inconclusive, never passes.

id: verification-verdict rejects output without a PASS marker
provenance: real Icarus behavior: $finish(1) still exits 0, so exit code alone is not evidence
notes: Positive evidence is required; quiet completion is not a pass.

id: verification-verdict rejects assertion failure output

tool_response.stdout: # ** ASSERTION FAILED: handshake stalled at 340 ns

provenance: ModelSim assertion output shape
notes: Assertion failures are functional failures.

id: verification-verdict rejects a nonzero exit status
provenance: a PASS string must not override an explicit nonzero exit code
notes: When the exit code is known and nonzero, output claims do not matter.

id: verification-verdict rejects a PostToolUseFailure event
provenance: real runtime event: Bash exit 143 timeout recorded in runtime_events
notes: The failure event itself is the verdict.

id: verification-gate blocks an unverified git commit
provenance: core verification-gate contract: commit with pending unverified edits
notes: Committing before functional verification must be blocked.

id: verification-gate blocks a build command while verification is pending
provenance: verification-required path for non-safe non-verification commands
notes: Unrelated work must not proceed while verification is pending.

id: verification-gate blocks a mixed verification chain
provenance: mixed-verification-chain rule: chaining hides which command produced the evidence
notes: Verification must be run as its own command.

id: verification-gate allows the verification command itself
provenance: the escape path out of a pending state must always be open
notes: Blocking the verification command would deadlock the session.

id: verification-gate allows a read-only command while pending
provenance: read-only git subcommands are on the safe list to avoid forcing gate resets
notes: Inspection must remain possible while verification is pending.

id: verification-gate allows lint with a warning, not a block
provenance: two-layer verification design: lint runs but does not clear pending
notes: Lint is allowed to run; it just is not functional verification.

id: verification-gate allows its own rescue command
provenance: documented escape hatch: the rescue command must survive being chained
notes: Losing the rescue path turns a false block into a dead session.

id: verification-gate allows any command with no pending edits
provenance: no pending edits means nothing to verify
notes: The gate must be inert when there is no unverified change.

id: toolchain-classify flags the Vivado Windows loader crash
provenance: real Windows STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND exit code observed with Vivado tooling
notes: A loader crash is a toolchain failure, not a design failure.

id: toolchain-classify flags a missing executable
provenance: real CI difference: EDA tools absent on runners while present locally
notes: Missing tools must not be reported as design failures.

id: toolchain-classify flags a license checkout failure

input.stderr: ERROR: license checkout failed for feature Synthesis

provenance: license failures are environment failures, seen with vendor tooling
notes: License failure is an environment problem.

id: toolchain-classify flags a silent nonzero toolchain exit
provenance: toolchain exited without diagnostic output branch
notes: No diagnostics plus nonzero exit means the toolchain, not the design.

id: toolchain-classify reports a real compile error as command failure
provenance: distinguishing design errors from toolchain errors is the point of the classifier
notes: A diagnostic-bearing failure is the design's fault, and still a failure.

id: toolchain-classify accepts a clean exit
provenance: baseline success path
notes: Exit code 0 with no error is a pass for the classifier.

id: evidence-status rejects a required command with no evidence
provenance: core evidence rule: model claims are not evidence
notes: A required verification command with no ledger entry fails closed.

id: evidence-status rejects a failing command entry
provenance: nonzero exit code in a ledger entry must make the ledger status failed
notes: Recorded failures cannot be summarized as success.

id: evidence-status accepts a real passing command entry
provenance: baseline: real command evidence with exit 0
notes: Real evidence for every required command is a pass.

id: evidence-status rejects a partially covered requirement set
provenance: one green command must not vouch for a second required command
notes: Every required command needs its own evidence entry.

id: evidence-status rejects a signal-killed command
provenance: real POSIX timeout behavior: killed simulations leave partial logs and no exit code
notes: A killed command is not a pass even with partial output.

id: evidence-status rejects an observed entry whose markers say failure
provenance: real Claude Code payloads carry no exit code; the D10 exitCodeKnown work added marker-based fallback judgement
notes: Missing exit code must fall back to output markers, not default to pass.

id: evidence-status accepts an observed entry with pass markers and no exit code
provenance: the common real case: hook payload without exit code but with explicit PASS evidence
notes: An unknown exit code must not by itself fail a well-evidenced run.

id: frustration-detector ignores failure evidence older than the TTL window

payload.prompt: 评价一下 harness 仓库的健壮程度。

provenance: real false positive fixed on 2026-07-29: a 19-day-old failureCount kept forcing mode switches across sessions
notes: Consecutive-failure counters must expire; stale counts are not evidence.

id: frustration-detector ignores a failure count with no parseable timestamp
provenance: same fix: unparseable timestamps are treated as stale rather than trusted
notes: Fail toward fewer interventions when evidence freshness is unknowable.

id: frustration-detector stays quiet on a normal work instruction

payload.prompt: 方案剩余部分继续施工,保证功能都闭环。

provenance: real user prompt from this session; ordinary instructions must not read as frustration
notes: Keyword-free instructions carry no frustration signal.

id: file-protection blocks a Write into matlab
provenance: PROTECTED_PATTERNS matlab directory
notes: Golden model writes require explicit per-file approval.

id: file-protection blocks an Edit of golden_model
provenance: PROTECTED_PATTERNS golden_model* glob
notes: Versioned golden directories are protected too.

id: file-protection blocks a MultiEdit of a protected model
provenance: real gap recorded in file-protection-guard: MultiEdit against a golden model had no guard at all
notes: Regression lock for the MultiEdit bypass.

id: file-protection blocks a write into engineering-assets models
provenance: asset library model directory added to PROTECTED_PATTERNS
notes: Shared asset models are protected like project golden models.

id: file-protection allows an RTL source write
provenance: the normal RTL authoring path
notes: Ordinary source writes must not be blocked by the model guard.

id: file-protection allows a testbench write
provenance: the normal testbench authoring path
notes: Testbenches are not protected model files.

id: frustration-detector injects a mode switch on fresh repeated failures
provenance: stop rule: change approach after two consecutive failures of the same method
notes: Fresh repeated failures should force a method change. Verdict block here means the harness intervened.

id: frustration-detector stays quiet on a neutral prompt with no failures

payload.prompt: 评价一下 harness 仓库的健壮程度。

provenance: false-positive control: a neutral question must not trigger mode switching
notes: No failures and no frustration means no intervention.

id: bash-safety allows a read-only search across golden model files
provenance: measured 2026-08-01: the old [>&]{2,} pattern matched the && separator while .(m|py|sh) matched .md, so this read-only grep was blocked as CRITICAL
notes: Gathering evidence about a golden model is the precondition for judging whether it should change; the gate must not punish it.

id: bash-safety blocks a single-redirect overwrite of a golden model
provenance: measured 2026-08-01: {2,} only covered the >> append form, so plain > overwrite (the more destructive one) was allowed
notes: Overwrite via a single > must be blocked like append.

id: bash-safety blocks tee into a golden model
provenance: tee is the redirect equivalent; source-write-bypass gained a tee pattern after a red-team bypass while the model side had none
notes: tee sidesteps > detection entirely.
